hook_text: My phone napped. I learned to whistle

song.title: Whistle Back
song.style: English, breezy skiffle folk with washboard, upright bass, strummed acoustic guitar and a whistled hook, warm friendly male lead vocal, sunny and light, 118 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Every ping would turn my head
Buzzing by my morning bread
Tucked my phone in for a nap
Eyelid shut, and that was that

[Chorus]
Whistle, whistle, try again
Sounds like wind in a watering can
Whistle, whistle, there it goes
A blackbird answered from the rose

[Verse]
Practised in the garden shed
Robin landed on my head
Sparrows on the washing line
Every beak in perfect time

[Chorus]
Whistle, whistle, loud and clear
Whole street stopped to lend an ear
Whistle, whistle, off we go
Me and the birds put on a show

shots.prompt: {moss} sits at a breakfast table, toast halfway to his mouth, and his head snaps toward a phone on the table that buzzes and glows softly. The camera whip-pans from his face to the phone. Bright morning kitchen light.
shots.frame: He sits at a breakfast table holding a slice of toast halfway to his mouth, looking sideways at a phone lying on the table. Medium shot. Bright morning kitchen light.

shots.prompt: A phone buzzes its way across a wooden table, rattling a teaspoon in a cup. Extreme close-up, the camera tracks with it. Bright morning light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, grumpy, a slice of toast in his hand, in a sunny kitchen. The camera pushes in. Bright morning light.
A slice of toast with jam slips from a clay hand and lands jam side down on a plate. Close-up, the camera tilts down fast. Bright morning light.
{moss} slides a phone into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve whose top edge looks like a closed eyelid with black lashes, then pats it gently. The camera pushes in on his hands. Warm morning light.
shots.frame: He stands at a kitchen table holding a phone in one hand and a slim terracotta-orange sleeve in the other, about to slide the phone in. Medium shot. Warm morning light.

shots.prompt: A slim terracotta-orange sleeve stands upright on a soft pale green backdrop, a phone tucked inside so only its top edge peeks out, the sleeve's top edge cut like a closed eyelid with black lashes. Soft leaf shadows drift across the backdrop. Warm daylight. The camera slowly pushes in as the light turns warmer.
{moss} leans back in his chair in the sudden quiet, looks around the kitchen and puckers his lips. The camera dolly zooms on him. Warm morning light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, cheeks puffed, in a garden full of flowers. The camera pushes in fast. Bright morning sun.
{moss} blows hard with puffed red cheeks and only a tiny puff of air comes out, his mustache flapping. Close-up, the camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
A dented green watering can wobbles on a garden path as wind whistles across its spout. Close-up, the camera orbits it. Bright morning sun.
{moss} stands among the flowers trying to whistle, face scrunched, one finger raised like a conductor. The camera orbits fast around him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} whistles and his eyes go wide with surprise as a clear note comes out, his beanie's pom-pom bouncing. The camera crash zooms in. Bright morning sun.
The leaves of a rose bush tremble as a sweet note rings through the garden. The camera whip-pans across the garden to the bush. Bright morning sun.
A glossy blackbird with a bright orange beak sits on a blooming rose bush, tilts its head and opens its beak to sing back. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
{moss} gasps and points at a blackbird on a rose bush, bouncing on his toes. The camera whip-pans from him to the bird. Bright morning sun.
{moss} stands in a cosy wooden garden shed full of flowerpots, practising his whistle with his eyes closed. The camera pushes in through the shed door. Dusty golden sunbeams.
Flowerpots on a shelf in a garden shed rattle and hop in time to a tune. Close-up, the camera tracks along the shelf. Dusty golden sunbeams.
A small round robin with a red breast flutters down and lands right on top of {moss}'s green beanie, and he freezes, eyes rolling up to look. The camera crash zooms in. Dusty golden sunbeams.
shots.frame: He stands in the doorway of a garden shed looking up with wide eyes, a small round robin with a red breast perched on top of his green beanie. Medium shot. Dusty golden sunbeams.

shots.prompt: {moss} slowly breaks into a grin with a robin perched on his beanie. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Dusty golden sunbeams.
shots.frame: A close-up of him smiling a little, a small round robin with a red breast perched on top of his green beanie, in a garden shed. Dusty golden sunbeams.

shots.prompt: Five plump brown sparrows land one by one on a washing line hung with striped socks. The camera tracks along the line. Bright midday sun.
{moss} stands in a garden waving a wooden spoon like a conductor's baton at five plump sparrows on a washing line. The camera orbits around him. Bright midday sun.
Five plump brown sparrows on a washing line open their beaks all together, bobbing in rhythm. Close-up, the camera whip-pans along them. Bright midday sun.
{moss} whistles with his eyes closed, swaying, a robin on his beanie swaying with him. The camera orbits slowly. Bright midday sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, joyful, a robin perched on his beanie, in a sunny garden. The camera pushes in fast. Bright midday sun.
{moss} marches down a garden path whistling, a blackbird, a robin and sparrows flying in a line behind him. The camera tracks backward in front of him. Bright midday sun.

{moss} walks down a street of crooked clay houses whistling, and a postman in a blue uniform with a big ginger mustache and a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses stop and turn their heads to listen as he passes. The camera cranes down to them. Bright afternoon sun.
A grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses cups a hand to her ear and smiles. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright afternoon sun.
{moss} strides along a street whistling, small birds perched along both of his outstretched arms. The camera tracks beside him. Golden afternoon light.
A postman in a blue uniform with a big ginger mustache whistles along and tosses his cap in the air. The camera crash zooms in. Golden afternoon light.

{moss} stands on an upturned crate in a little town square whistling, a blackbird on one hand and sparrows on his shoulders, while a grandma in a purple cardigan and pearl glasses claps. The camera cranes up and around. Golden evening light.
A row of little birds on a rooftop gutter sing into a golden sunset. The camera cranes up past them into the sky. Golden evening light.
{moss} sits on a garden bench at sunset with a robin asleep on his beanie and breathes out slowly with a small smile. The camera pulls back slowly. Golden evening light.

caption: moss tucked his phone into the Eyelid and learned to whistle. the birds had notes. now they tour together
